summary: Aya Gold & Silver Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release reporting high-grade exploration drill results at its Boumadine project in Morocco. The release details multiple intercepts of silver-equivalent grades, e.g., 890 g/t AgEq over 51.5m, and provides an update on the ongoing infill drilling program (69,209m drilled year-to-date, 11 rigs active). No corporate transaction, board recommendation, or financial terms are mentioned. This is a routine operational update by a foreign private issuer.
